reviews.review:
The legacy of Left 4 Dead continues!! 
This game has so much potential. I played it on gamepass and still play it to this day, now I’m trying it on steam. I love Left 4 Dead (jusy look at my play history) and this game I can tell has so much passion behind it. Highly recommend it. Great Co op fun !

Anacrusis, a cooperative first-person shooter set in a retro-futuristic sci-fi world, is an absolute blast that harmonizes thrilling action with a dose of humor and unique gameplay mechanics. Developed by Stray Bombay Company, this game takes a fresh approach to the genre, offering an engaging and entertaining experience for both solo players and teams.

The premise of Anacrusis is as intriguing as it is simple: you're a member of a team of survivors aboard a mysterious, sentient starship. Your mission is to fend off waves of hostile alien creatures and navigate the ship's sprawling corridors to unravel its secrets. What sets this game apart is its focus on cooperative play. While it can be played solo, Anacrusis truly shines when you're joined by friends or fellow players who share the same goal - survival.

The first thing that strikes you about Anacrusis is its visual style. The retro-futuristic design aesthetic, reminiscent of the 1970s, combines neon colors, groovy patterns, and futuristic tech. The ship's interiors are beautifully detailed, creating an immersive atmosphere that feels both nostalgic and futuristic. The lighting and environmental effects add to the overall ambiance, making each level a visual delight.

Gameplay in Anacrusis is where it truly stands out. It's a mix of teamwork, resource management, and strategic decision-making. Players choose from a diverse cast of characters, each with unique abilities that can significantly impact the outcome of a match. The game encourages cooperation and communication between team members, as success often depends on combining your strengths and resources effectively.

The gunplay is satisfying, and the variety of weapons and tools at your disposal keeps things interesting. Ammo and health management play a crucial role in the game, adding a layer of strategy as you scavenge for supplies while fending off waves of alien enemies. The procedural level generation ensures that no two playthroughs are the same, increasing replayability and challenge.

One standout feature is the dynamic Director AI. Anacrusis adapts to your performance, keeping the gameplay fresh and unpredictable. This keeps you on your toes, making it hard to anticipate what challenges lie ahead. The game also incorporates a unique voting system at the end of each level, allowing players to decide on the direction they'll take next, adding a layer of player agency to the experience.

What sets Anacrusis apart from other shooters is its sharp sense of humor. The witty banter and humorous dialogues between characters make for a lighthearted and entertaining experience. It's a great reminder that games can be both intense and fun.

While Anacrusis is an absolute delight, it's not without its minor flaws, such as occasional bugs or technical hiccups. However, these issues don't significantly detract from the overall experience and are likely to be addressed by future updates.

In conclusion, Anacrusis is a remarkable addition to the cooperative shooter genre, offering a refreshing take on teamwork, humor, and strategy. Its unique visual style, engaging gameplay, and dynamic AI Director make it a must-play for fans of cooperative shooters. Whether you're looking to survive waves of alien attackers with friends or take on the challenge solo, Anacrusis hits all the right notes, making it an absolute delight for sci-fi and shooter enthusiasts alike.

really lovely aesthetic and gunplay. the only negative thing is the overall sound design of the game. the ambience is nice, but the music is unfitting in some places, and the escalation of danger and urgency isnt really emphasised through it. for such a funky aesthetic and overall theme, a more fitting sound track would take it so far! As well as this, the voice acting is super lackluster. the VA's sound bored and very uninspired. A little bit of flair and personality would do wonders for the immersion and story telling and overall more enjoyable experience! I am hopeful though, as its really a super idea and has so much potential and so far having a lot of fun playing :)!

overall aesthetic is fantastic, level design is great, gun-play is uniquely fun. characters lack overall personality and uniqueness, and could do with a lot more story. asides from the negatives, it's a distinctively structured and promising game with especially creatively designed special enemies and satisfying combat.

I absolutely love this game and it has been great to see how much its progressed since the last time I played! Excited to see how much it grows!! I definitely recommend everyone to try it out especially with friends! <3
A really strong L4D successor with a really welcoming community. It's strong and getting stronger with each release.

This was a positive review but after about a month of waiting for the game to improve I have to say the game is going into a direction I think is killing itself. Games gets boring really fast, there's no real replayability just a difficulty scaling, you will constantly ask yourself "am i even going the right way?". Lacks way too many qol features. In higher difficulty your whole screen just gets covered in aliens where you cant really do anything about it and just end up dying. It's probably fun to run thru normal difficulty once or twice with a buddy but after that you'll end up not touching the game until there's another update. And for these reasons I can not suggest anyone to get this game, idk maybe wait for a few more updates to revisit and getting the game.

very excited to see where this game goes. fell into it for two hours straight and played through eps 1-5 with some NPCs last night and had so much fun. it's certainly early access, but it isn't broken or frustrating at all, just clearly still cooking. the levels are bright, you get a flashlight, and the music preps you for what's about to happen so while ♥♥♥♥ got BAD and SCARY and INTENSE in some places, i was never jump scared which i appreciate a LOT. played on normal difficulty, with the other options being intense and intenser. and because i'm a controller gamer and BAD AT IT, through gameplay settings i happily enabled all the bullet bending and aim assist offered. i didn't notice it helping, but i felt like a Real Gamer so it clearly did.

lots of long ass hallways and choke points, places to get cornered, things to check out and weapons and upgrades and health pretty much anywhere you need if things get desperate enough, but like, not enough for everyone on the team to play as recklessly as i do. incredible scale and levels that inspired me to let a few NPCs die while checking things out, a few times. but now that i know, there's almost always time to look around or press forward, once you fully step in ♥♥♥♥ on that particular leg of the level.

Avoid  until it improves.

The gameplay is beyond boring, the shooting is unfulfilling and way too cartoonish. The overall game feels like someone's weekend project. 

The fps zombie horde genre is stacked with AAA titles like world war Z, back 4 blood, etc and unless you can bring something new or competitive then you're at a disadvantage already.

The feedback is largely critical of this game and the response is seemingly immature. If you're limited by the number of people on your team, time or resources then it's only a matter of time before the free market determines your fate.


TLDR, It's goofy and plays like a demo.
Very well done online coop game in the spirit of World war Z and back 4 blood. Underrated and can improve even more if more players were online/active.
